svg.title: What rested on the deleted fact
svg.desc: The first server run, after dream 2. The explicit row 'Anton has followed a strict vegetarian diet for eight years' was deleted. Three conclusions cite it. The update, 'Anton transitioned from a vegetarian diet to a pescatarian diet in June 2026', cites it on purpose. 'Anton is likely to order vegetarian Indian food featuring paneer during his dinner' is still live and carries the old value. Dream 1's pattern 'consistently prioritizes vegetarian options' was replaced by a near duplicate written in dream 2, after the update: 'a consistent preference for vegetarian cuisine', confidence high, derived twice, which cites the old pattern. The peer card was rewritten from Vegetarian to Pescatarian. Bottom: a dream's delete stamps only the rows it names; removing a session from a scope deletes every derived row with a deleted source, repeatedly, and would delete all three live rows here, the update included.
